intro: Monitor Mode turns the Claude Code and Codex sessions you start in a terminal or IDE into characters in the office. It uses each agent's hooks: no API key, no extra cost, and nothing to install besides the agents themselves.
observeOnly: Monitored sessions are view-only. Agentville can't send prompts, approve tools or stop them — do that in the terminal.

claude.label: Claude Code location
claude.hint: Detected automatically. Set a path only if Claude Code is installed somewhere unusual.

receiver.title: Local receiver
receiver.hint: Built into Agentville. Listens only on 127.0.0.1 and accepts events signed with this computer's private token.
receiver.portHint: Changing the port requires reinstalling the hooks.
receiver.autoStart: Start the receiver when Agentville opens

hooks.title: {{name}} hooks
hooks.hint: Adds Agentville entries to your user settings. Your other settings and hooks are kept untouched, and a backup is written first.
hooks.stale: Installed, but for a different port, token or Agentville location. Reinstall to update.
hooks.restartSessions: Sessions that were already running need to be restarted to pick up the hooks.

agents.title: Other agents
agents.hint: Sessions from other coding agents can join the office too. Every character shows which agent runs it (CC = Claude Code, CX = Codex); they never affect each other.
agents.notDetected: {{name}} wasn't found on this computer. You can connect anyway; it takes effect once you start using it.
agents.disconnected: {{name}} disconnected; only Agentville's entries were removed.
agents.stale: The connection is out of date (for example, Agentville moved). Click “Update connection”, then trust the hook again in the agent.
agents.trustTitle: Last step: trust Agentville's hook in {{name}}
agents.trustAfter: {{name}} skips hooks until you trust them. Once you do, its next action shows up in the office and this card turns “Connected” by itself. Sessions that are already open may need a restart.
agents.liveIdle: Connected. Start working in {{name}} and its characters walk into the office.

codex.trustCli: Terminal: when codex starts it warns that hooks need review. Type /hooks, pick Agentville's entries and trust them.
codex.trustApp: Desktop app: click “Review hooks” in the composer, or open Settings → Hooks, and trust Agentville's entries.

desktopOnly: Setup is available in the Agentville desktop app.

live.setupBody: Connect Agentville to Claude Code so sessions you run in a terminal appear here. Takes about a minute; no API key needed.
live.waitingBody: Start claude in a terminal and send a prompt. Each session walks into the office as its own character.
live.hooksMissingBody: The receiver is running, but Claude Code doesn't know about it. Install the hooks to start monitoring.

notify.connected: {{name}} is connected; its agents will appear in the office.

welcome.title: Welcome to your AI office
welcome.body: Agentville shows your Claude Code agents as characters in a pixel-art office, reacting to what they actually do.
welcome.chooseTitle: How would you like to start?
welcome.liveBody: Watch the sessions you run in a terminal. Free, no API key — a short checklist helps you set it up.
welcome.demoBody: Scripted characters show what the office can do. Clearly labelled; switch to Live any time.

gitWindows: Git for Windows isn't installed. Claude Code uses it to run shell commands, and Agentville uses it to show branches. Install it from
